doc: Every system the mashup has. One row = one Java class (or native/tool unit). dependsOn lists other system ids. test = how the row is proven; verified flips to true only after that test passed.

rows.purpose: Find the player's Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel install from Steam's libraryfolders.vdf (app 1449850) and its LocalData/<id>/0000 bundle folder. Env DUELCRAFT_MD_DIR overrides.
rows.test: unit test finds C:/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/Yu-Gi-Oh!  Master Duel

rows.purpose: LZ4 block decompression for UnityFS blocks.
rows.test: unit test: bundle blocks decompress to their declared sizes

rows.purpose: Read a UnityFS bundle: header, LZ4 block/directory info, nodes (serialized file + .resS).
rows.test: unit test: card_prop bundle opens, node list matches UnityPy

rows.purpose: Parse a Unity 6 serialized file (v22) with type trees; read objects as maps through the type tree (TextAsset, Texture2D, AssetBundle container).
rows.test: unit test: TextAsset bytes and Texture2D fields equal UnityPy's

rows.purpose: Map asset paths -> bundle files by reading each bundle's AssetBundle container once; cache to <instance>/duelcraft/md_index.tsv, rebuilt when the LocalData listing changes.
rows.test: unit test: index contains card_prop/card_name/card_desc/card_indx and illust/<cid>.bmp; timing logged

rows.purpose: Decrypt (brute-force key, zlib) and parse card_prop/card_indx/card_name/card_desc into MdCard rows (cid, name, text, raw props).
rows.test: unit test: 14,327 rows; cid 4007 is 'Blue-Eyes White Dragon' ATK 3000

rows.purpose: Join Master Duel rows with cards.tsv (passcode, setcodes, overrides) and the kind/race/attribute/link sheets into CardInfo (engine data + display data). Lookup by cid and by passcode.
rows.test: unit test: conversion equals the generator's check for every mapped card

rows.purpose: Extract duelcraft_native.dll (ocgcore + BC7 decoder) from the jar to <instance>/duelcraft/native and bind it with the Java FFM API.
rows.test: unit test: OCG_GetVersion returns 11.0

rows.purpose: Card illustration for a cid: find illust/<cid>.bmp bundle (tcg first, then common), decode BC7 via native_lib, cache PNG in <instance>/duelcraft/art/<cid>.png.
rows.test: unit test: cid 4064 decodes to a 512x512 image matching UnityPy's

rows.purpose: Serve EDOPro Lua scripts (constant.lua, utility.lua, proc_*.lua, c<passcode>.lua) from cardscripts.zip shipped in the jar.
rows.test: unit test: c55144522.lua (Pot of Greed) loads

rows.purpose: FFM binding of ocgapi.h: create/destroy duel, new card, start, process, get message, set response, query location/field; card/script/log upcalls.
rows.test: unit test: a duel with two 40-card decks starts and reaches MSG_SELECT_IDLECMD

rows.purpose: Split the length-prefixed message buffer; decode every prompt (duel_prompts sheet) and display event (duel_events sheet) into records.
rows.test: AI-vs-AI soak test decodes every message without leftover bytes

rows.purpose: Snapshot of the field after each process step from OCG_DuelQueryLocation (both players, all locations) with per-viewer hiding (opponent hand, face-down, decks).
rows.test: AI-vs-AI soak test: snapshot card counts equal OCG_DuelQueryCount

rows.purpose: Answer every prompt for a computer duelist following ai_policies; never sends an invalid response twice (falls back, then concedes).
rows.test: AI-vs-AI soak test: 30 duels with the sheet decks all end with MSG_WIN, no stalls

rows.purpose: One duel: two seats (ServerPlayer or AI), runs the core on the server thread, routes prompts to seats, applies responses, broadcasts state/events, ends with rewards.
rows.test: in-game: player vs zombie duel plays to a win

rows.purpose: Challenges (player->mob, player->player with accept), one duel per participant, ticking, forfeit on disconnect/death, /duel command.
rows.test: in-game: challenge, accept, forfeit and disconnect paths

rows.purpose: Freeze a challenged mob (no AI, invulnerable, facing the player) for the duel and restore it after; pick its deck from mob_duelists.
rows.test: in-game: zombie stands still and is restored after the duel

rows.purpose: World board: mat + CardEntity per occupied zone between the duelists, updated from DuelState; attack lunge animation.
rows.test: in-game screenshot shows cards on the mat matching the duel screen

rows.purpose: Synced entity showing one card (cid, face up/down, attack/defense) or the mat; no collision, not saved.
rows.test: in-game: entity renders the card art

rows.purpose: Register the items sheet (card, deck box), data components and the creative tab with every card.
rows.test: in-game: creative tab lists cards; tooltip shows name/stats/text

rows.purpose: Deck box container: 60 main + 15 extra slots that only take cards (extra deck types go to extra), saved in the deck box item.
rows.test: in-game: put cards in, close, reopen, still there; deck used in duel

rows.purpose: On a player's first join in a world give a deck box holding the starter deck (decks sheet) and a chat hint.
rows.test: in-game: new world -> deck box in inventory with 40 cards

rows.purpose: Survival collecting: hostile mobs drop a random playable card (chance in config), duel wins give a card from the loser's deck.
rows.test: in-game: /duel testdrop and a kill drop a card item

rows.purpose: Register the payloads sheet with Fabric networking (StreamCodecs) and route them.
rows.test: in-game: prompt reaches client, response reaches server

rows.purpose: Card art as DynamicTextures (duelcraft:art/<cid>) loaded off-thread from art_cache, with a placeholder until ready.
rows.test: in-game: tooltip and duel screen show real art

rows.purpose: Tooltip component drawing the card art, name, stats and wrapped Master Duel effect text.
rows.test: in-game screenshot of a hovered card

rows.purpose: Full-screen duel field (ui_widgets): zones, hand, LP, phase, log, card preview, and the prompt widgets that send responses.
rows.test: in-game: a whole duel is playable from this screen

rows.purpose: In-world overlay while dueling: LP, phase, whose turn, pending prompt and the key to open the duel screen.
rows.test: in-game screenshot in world view during a duel

rows.purpose: Render CardEntity as a flat card quad with art (or card back) and the mat.
rows.test: in-game screenshot of the board

rows.purpose: Title-screen/in-game message when Master Duel isn't installed or still being indexed (progress).
rows.test: in-game with DUELCRAFT_MD_DIR pointing nowhere shows the message

rows.purpose: Melty multiplayer: auto Open-to-LAN on world load when DUELCRAFT_LAN_PORT is set (e4mc logs 'Domain assigned: '), auto-join join=<address> from config/duelcraft.properties at the title screen.
rows.test: two instances on this PC: host world, second instance joins through the e4mc address, they duel

rows.purpose: Build duelcraft_native.dll = ocgcore (AGPL) + bcdec BC7 (MIT) + dc_decode_bc7 export with MSVC.
rows.test: dll exports OCG_* and dc_decode_bc7

rows.purpose: Build cards.tsv and the kind/race/attribute/link sheets from Master Duel data with BabelCDB as an oracle (not shipped).
rows.test: 12,989+ cards convert exactly; overrides cover the rest

rows.purpose: Generate Java from the sheets (one record/entry per row).
rows.test: build compiles generated sources

rows.purpose: Cross every sheet's rows and columns: unfilled cells, unresolved references, deck cards without passcode/script.
rows.test: runs clean before each build

rows.purpose: Release zip: portable Prism Launcher + DuelCraft instance (Fabric 26.3) with duelcraft, fabric-api, e4mc jars and credits.
rows.test: inspect_package/validate_recipe/one_click_check pass; Melty Play works on this PC

rows.purpose: Find Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Links: DUELCRAFT_DL_DIR (Melty passes {game:custom-yu-gi-oh-duel-links}), else Steam app 601510; its LocalData/<id> bundle folder.
rows.test: unit test finds this PC's Duel Links

rows.purpose: Index Duel Links bundles (reuses MasterDuelIndex, cache duelcraft/dl_index.tsv) and list characters that have both a face portrait and voice clips.
rows.test: unit test: 190+ characters, Jaden (0101) has 6 faces and voice clips

rows.purpose: Clip id -> Ogg bytes: read the AudioClip resource, parse FSB5, rebuild Ogg Vorbis (setup header from vorbis_headers.bin, granule positions from block sizes).
rows.test: unit test: rebuilt Ogg decodes with JOrbis to the clip's sample count

rows.purpose: Card-specific lines (dl/card_lines.tsv: character, clip, card cid) and the voice_categories sheet: pick the clip for (character, trigger, card).
rows.test: unit test: Jaden has a card_summon line for Elemental HERO Neos

rows.purpose: Play a clip through Minecraft's sound engine: SoundInstance on event duelcraft:voice whose Sound points at duelcraft_dl:voice/<clip>; SoundBufferLibraryMixin serves the Ogg from dl_voice.
rows.test: in-game: Jaden says DUEL! at duel start

rows.purpose: Turn duel events into lines for the acting seat's character (card line first, else the generic category), one line at a time, and set that seat's portrait expression.
rows.test: in-game: summon/activation/attack/damage/win lines play for both seats

rows.purpose: Key (default K) opens a grid of every Duel Links character (their icon, which carries the name); the pick is saved in config/duelcraft.properties and sent to the server.
rows.test: in-game screenshot of the menu; pick survives restart

rows.purpose: Duel Links character images as textures (icon, name plate, 6 faces); the duel screen shows both seats' faces beside their LP.
rows.test: in-game screenshot of the duel screen with portraits

rows.purpose: Each player's picked character (CharacterPickPayload), included in DuelStartPayload for both seats so friends hear each other.
rows.test: two clients: each hears the other's character

rows.purpose: Melty test runs (recipe test.checks): while %LOCALAPPDATA%/Melty/test/duelcraft.json exists, open a fresh peaceful world from the test seed, pick a Duel Links character from the seed, duel a villager with the duel AI answering every prompt, and append pass/fail lines for cards-loaded, characters-loaded, duel-starts, voice-plays, portrait-shows, duel-finishes.
rows.test: local rehearsal with DUELCRAFT_MELTY_TEST, then Melty test_release (2+ runs)
